heads.en: On the Power and the Will of God

headnotes.la: …men praescientiae parificari non potest, quia praescientia Dei et ad ea quae facturus est pertinet, et ad ea quae permissurus. Praedestinatio autem ad ea quae facturus est tantum. Ambrosius enim dicit
headnotes.en: …se God's foreknowledge pertains both to those things which he is going to do and to those which he is going to permit. But predestination only to those things which he is going to do. For Ambrose says
